description: When the model tier ladder is exhausted on a test failure or an environment/pre-existing failure blocks a flow, test_failure_loop halts or returns blocked without recording blocked_on and a structured parked record.
goal: Extend apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/test_failure_loop.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/local_tests.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/local_test_finding.py, and (for any public flow/review re-exports such as parked_record_from_ci_status) apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/lazy_exports_review.py — keeping every module strictly at or below 350 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json — so that: (1) when the model tier ladder is exhausted on an environment, pre-existing, or unresolved test failure, the outcome parks cleanly with a structured parked record containing blocked_on (blocker bean id or PR number derived from classifier evidence or explicit mapping, or 'none' when unattributed), classification, failing_ids, signature, evidence, and full ledger rows for every tier attempt, plus checkpoint_path schema fields for watcher consumption; (2) add hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_test_failure_loop.py and update companion tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_local_test_finding.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_review_local_tests.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_review_local_test_failure.py covering: (a) exhaustion on an environment failure parks with blocked_on; (b) exhaustion on an unresolved failure with no blocker parks with blocked_on == 'none' and evidence rather than halting; (c) an introduced failure fixed by the runner does not park; (d) a failure signature seen once creates no KB failure mode entry. Run uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Parking cleanly with a structured blocked_on record lets automated unblock watchers resume stalled flows as soon as their blocker lands.
acceptance_criteria: After the tier ladder is exhausted on an environment, pre-existing or unresolved test failure, test_failure_loop.py / local_tests.py parks with blocked_on naming the blocking bean or PR and the ledger rows for every attempt.

Structured parked record in test_failure_loop.py / local_tests.py / local_test_finding.py (with any public review-helper re-export registered in lazy_exports_review.py) exposes blocked_on, evidence, signature, attempt ledger rows, and checkpoint_path schema fields for automated watcher consumption.

Tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_test_failure_loop.py and companion assertions in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_local_test_finding.py with a fake runner verify: (a) exhaustion on an environment failure parks with blocked_on; (b) exhaustion on an unresolved failure with no blocker parks with blocked_on: none and evidence rather than halting; (c) an introduced failure that is fixed does not park; (d) a failure signature seen once creates no KB failure mode entry; uv run pytest passes cleanly.

Companion local-test regression suites in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_review_local_tests.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_review_local_test_failure.py cover local_tests.py parked-record and error-handling behavior and pass under uv run pytest and uv run task lint.
